configurePresets.name: nrf-macos
configurePresets.description: Uses the NCS v3.4.1 toolchain manager bundle installed at /opt/nordic on this machine. Override with -DNRF_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT=<path> if yours differs.

configurePresets.name: nrf-linux
configurePresets.description: No verified default toolchain path for Linux yet. Export NRF_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT to your NCS toolchain's arm-zephyr-eabi directory, or put arm-zephyr-eabi-gcc on PATH, before configuring with this preset.

configurePresets.name: nrf-windows
configurePresets.description: No verified default toolchain path for Windows yet. Set NRF_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT to your NCS toolchain's arm-zephyr-eabi directory, or put arm-zephyr-eabi-gcc.exe on PATH, before configuring with this preset.

configurePresets.name: stm32-macos
configurePresets.description: Uses the ARM GNU Toolchain installed at /Applications/ArmGNUToolchain on this machine. Override with -DSTM32_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT=<path> if yours differs.

configurePresets.name: stm32-linux
configurePresets.description: No verified default toolchain path for Linux yet. Export STM32_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT to your ARM GNU Toolchain install dir, or put arm-none-eabi-gcc on PATH, before configuring with this preset.

configurePresets.name: stm32-windows
configurePresets.description: No verified default toolchain path for Windows yet. Set STM32_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT to your ARM GNU Toolchain install dir, or put arm-none-eabi-gcc.exe on PATH, before configuring with this preset.
